model: Micah Flagship Deluxe Special Needs Tricycle MICAH-FLAG-LIME
description:
The Ultimate trike for children and small adults with special needs, and disabilities featuring rear care giver steering controls.

New for 2023--The Totally Redesigned Micah Adaptive Trike ***CLICK HERE FOR FULL MICAH FEATURES AND MEASUREMENTS!*** The newly upgraded Micah Flagship Deluxe... the next generation of the finest tricycle designed for those in the 6 years old - small adults category. This amazing tricycle is so feature rich. The Micah Flagship features are incredible for those with special needs... adjustable seat with back support, loop handlebar with caliper brake, Side Adjustable seat supports, adaptive pedals and adjustable headrest. The all new design has a rear caregiver steering unit to control the ride and the drive train is all internal. Handlebars, seat, side support and headrest are adjustable to insure comfort and safety. Wheels are all quick release making transporting options far greater This is a fixed drive cycle (pedals turn whenever the cycle is on motion. Pedal forward, go forward, pedal backwards, go backwards. Comes in a very attractive Neon-Lime Green color for ultimate visibility and style
